title: Comments on files outside the project, round 2: same buttons as other permission cards

steps.path: Any chat, when the assistant reaches for comments on a file in another folder
steps.headline: Instead of refusing, the assistant asks with the usual Yes / No card, where the middle button reads Allow for this chat.
steps.changed: Today the comment step fails on any file outside the chat's project. Now it pauses on the same card every other permission uses: green Yes, blue middle button, red No, and a short note underneath. Round 1 used the browser's wording and put the note on top; that is gone.
steps.notice: Yes covers this one step. Allow for this chat stops the question for every outside file until the chat ends or the app restarts. No tells the assistant no.
steps.risk: Allow for this chat covers comments on any file on the computer for that chat, not just this folder (your choice). It never lets the assistant edit those files.

steps.path: The same card at phone width
steps.headline: On a phone, No moves to a second line rather than squeezing the middle button onto two lines.
steps.changed: The same card, drawn narrow. Nothing else moves.
steps.notice: You can answer from your phone while away from the computer.
steps.risk: The card is one line taller on a phone than the normal Yes / Always allow / No card, because Allow for this chat is longer than Always allow.
